text.en: Dog owners consistently highlight the patience, transparency, and deep knowledge demonstrated by trainers like Eddie, Juan, and Rey. Reviewers note that staff take time to explain each training phase clearly, establish realistic expectations, and ensure owners learn how to reinforce commands and routines at home.

Clients report significant transformations in dog behavior, noting dramatic reductions in leash pulling, reactivity around other pets, and anxious habits. Reviewers emphasize that both energetic puppies and reactive adult dogs become calm, focused, and responsive to commands even in distracting public settings.

Owners appreciate the gentle, affectionate approach shown to family pets throughout their training stays. Clients report that nervous or stubborn dogs develop greater self-assurance, stay happy and engaged during their sessions, and return home feeling secure, balanced, and comfortable in various environments.

q.en: What training methods and programs does Asger K9 offer?

a.en: According to client reviews, Asger K9 provides board and train programs, puppy obedience, and behavioral modification for issues like reactivity and leash pulling.

q.en: Do trainers teach owners how to maintain commands at home?

a.en: Yes, reviewers emphasize that trainers dedicate one-on-one time with owners during pickup to ensure commands and routines are practiced consistently at home.

q.en: Are updates provided while dogs are in board and train programs?

a.en: Yes, clients mention receiving regular updates, photos, and progress reports while their dogs are enrolled in training programs.
